derivation: The ontology's canonical names, unchanged, so the phrase grounder's prompt path is recorded rather than implicit. Separate from the OWLv2 and SAM 3 vocabularies under D56: a CLIP-style text tower, a presence head and a phrase grounder do not respond alike, and Grounding DINO in particular consumes a period-separated phrase list and returns spans over it, so its prompts must be single lowercase noun phrases that survive span extraction. This is the baseline, fitted on nothing; a searched vocabulary for this adapter would be fitted on development data only and frozen before the held-out panel, per D57.
